t.why: It confronts China more sharply than anyone over the South China Sea. It is a US ally and has expanded US military access to its bases.
t.rel: A US ally that often clashes with the Chinese coast guard over islands and reefs in the South China Sea. It won an international arbitration case in 2016, but China rejects the ruling.
t.korea: It fought in the Korean War. Many Filipinos work in Korea, and it is a popular destination for Korean travelers.
t.know: Banana ketchup, a Filipino favorite, was invented during World War II when tomatoes ran short.
t.etext: Remittances from workers abroad and business process outsourcing such as call centers are the two pillars of the economy. It also sells chip assembly and nickel ore.
